payload.instruction: Move the book behind the flower
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what change, if any, is visible in the placement of the same book relative to the same flower?
node.criteria: complete: the book is visibly behind the flower in the edited image, with clear depth ordering such as the flower occluding the book. partial: the book has been repositioned in a way that visibly advances it toward being behind the flower, even if the depth ordering is not yet complete; mere proximity or movement toward the flower without evidence of advancing the behind relation is not progress. absent: no visible progress toward placing the book behind the flower. Ignore unrelated changes to the book or flowers. unknown: evidence is insufficient to compare the objects or determine progress.
node.binding: Source and edited images: identify the book and flower in the source, then compare those same objects in the edited image. Assess the book's placement and depth ordering relative to the flower.

outcome.description: Move the book behind the flower, including the requested relative depth ordering.
